title: ever SEVYN|Ruffled Sleeve Empire Waist Lace Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with this stunning Short Sleeve Ruffled Empire Waist Asymmetrical Midi Formal Evening Dress! Designed to flatter, the empire waist creates a beautiful silhouette while the ruffled short sleeves add a touch of playful elegance. The asymmetrical hemline brings a modern twist, making it perfect for any formal occasion, from weddings to galas. Crafted from luxurious fabric, this dress drapes effortlessly, ensuring you feel as good as you look.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch
